lines.en: I shuffle over to the stall

lines.zh: 我的脚步沉下去又起来
lines.en: My steps sink and rise
I walk toward where you stand
I do not speak, I only walk
I go around a heap of stone
My hands hang still
I near the stall step by step
I lift the hem of my robe a little

lines.zh: 我走到能看清你的地方
lines.en: I move to where I can see you
I drag my steps across
I go around the table to you
I stand and wait for customers
A row of eggs sits on my table
I neither speak nor stir
My gaze rests on nothing
I fold my hands in front
I wait for you to speak first
My shadow holds still
I weigh a small bag

lines.zh: 我朝桌边的位置看了看
lines.en: I glance at the place by the table
I draw one slow breath
I set a coin straight
I shake out my sleeves
I wait for the next customer
A whole row of eggs lies before me
I turn one egg half around

lines.zh: 商人不还价，只换刷怪蛋。
lines.en: This merchant does not haggle, only trades spawn eggs.
What have you brought

lines.zh: 我把桌上的一只蛋推前
lines.en: I push one egg forward
I look at the goods before I speak
Your hands hold nothing
You mean to trade this
I nod slowly
Set it on the table
I trade here, I do not sell
I square the goods on the table

lines.zh: 我把你要的东西看了一眼
lines.en: I glance at what you want

lines.zh: 我伸手示意桌上的位置
lines.en: I gesture at the spot on the table
I stay silent until you finish
I grip the table edge
I make no sound at all
I draw my hand back
I straighten up slowly
Nothing on the table has moved
I lift my eyes to look at you
Business hours. Hands off.
Hit the merchant—who trades your eggs then?
A full stack is what it takes
Not enough for even one egg
I look at you and do not take it
Take it back
I shake my head slowly
This will get you nothing
Add a little more to it
What I want is the whole stack
You bumped my stall
I catch one egg with my hand
I step back half a pace
The goods on the table rock
I bend and set the egg back
I said nothing at all
You nearly swept the whole row
I put a hand at the table edge
I do not like that at all
I return to my place
I wait here for trades
The table is my place
I need say nothing else

lines.zh: 这些事不在我的单子上
lines.en: That is not on my list
I keep waiting right here
Set that matter aside
I point at the table
Trades only, nothing else
I go quiet again
I pick up an egg
It is heavier than it looks

lines.zh: 我把它放回原处，换蛋的价还没谈完。
lines.en: I put it back; the egg price is not settled.
I count them and put them back
I keep nothing for myself
I set it straight
I look and set it down
This does not belong here
I push it toward you
I put it in the chest below
I move the eggs forward
Which one will you trade for
I lay a hand on the table
I wait for you to set it down
I fix on the pile in your hands
This trade can be made
You set it first, then I move
I count out the number you need
I take up an egg
I put a hand under the table
I line the eggs up in a row
You push the goods a little closer

lines.zh: 我不说话，只把货物摆出来。
lines.en: I say nothing. I only lay out the goods.
I keep my hand on the table
Your goods are not yet steady
I am waiting on the last one
I hold the egg in my hand
I watch you and the pile alike
Your hand is drawing back
I raise it where you can see
I count it over again
Only this one piece is missing
Push the last piece over
I count what you offer
My hand stops in midair
Back off, and I take it back
I wait for one more piece
I tap the egg lightly
I put a hand before the table
I draw the eggs back
I take one step back
I shield the table with my body
I did not strike back at all
I close the chest
I shake my head and take it away
I make no sound at that
I withdraw behind the stall
The command is spoken, and I am here
I appear behind the table
I rest my hands on the table's edge
A row of eggs is laid before me
A little light joins the air
I move out of stillness
The stall is complete at once
I stand, saying nothing
My shadow falls on the table
I set the first egg straight
Light from above falls on my shoulder
I take my stand behind the table
Everything around goes quiet
Flame licks at my cuff
I land and drop to one knee
The water rises and I still stand
The blast overturns my table
An arrow stands in the tabletop
Magic scatters around me
I never eat, it has merely been long
Lightning runs down my robe
I fall still watching the table
